children: B.AI said its cumulative registered users have surpassed 2,400,612, rising from 2.3 million to more than 2.4 million on September 9. According to ChainCatcher, the platform described itself as infrastructure for the AI agent era and said it aims to promote efficient circulation and sharing of intelligent computing power.

title: B.AI Says Registered Users Exceed 2.4 Million
